This is the file research/v2/engine/train_runner.py actually reads. Its partition boundary dates and rules (TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT/VALIDATION/FINAL_TEST start/end, thesis_assignment_rule, child_inheritance_rule, boundary_censoring_rule, warmup_context_rule) are pre-registered policy, independent of data, and remain correct/unchanged by V2.10B. Its canonical_fingerprint and split_plan_fingerprint fields are inherited from the UNVERIFIED data/manifest.json and must not be treated as confirmed until the real dataset is loaded and its fingerprint independently recomputed via research.v2.data.live_dataset.load_frozen_live_dataset.

known_algorithm_inconsistency.finding: research/v2/data/models.py:compute_dataset_fingerprint and research/v2/data/manifest.py:compute_canonical_fingerprint are two different hash algorithms over the same CandleV2 content (different string format, different rounding, and manifest.py's version pre-sorts by (timestamp_open_utc, timeframe.name) while models.py's does not sort at all). It is not currently documented which of the two the value 8f5a20fd6b77dbebcfcf756b16e670cfb39712ff3e2b18a59f49073bd189e042 in data/manifest.json was supposed to have been computed with.
known_algorithm_inconsistency.reason_not_fixed: Unifying them touches research/v2/data/resampler.py's ResamplingProvenance and every fingerprint-dependent determinism check across V2.10A, which is out of scope for a data-engineering/provenance-only phase. research/v2/data/live_dataset.py (new in V2.10B) uses manifest.py's compute_canonical_fingerprint, since it is the function paired with the DatasetManifest schema it reuses. This must be resolved before the real dataset's fingerprint can be authoritatively verified.
